doc.description:
---- adapt /api/graph nodes to RAW force-graph shape (fallback when
the server did not send data.force; mirrors graph_force.py) ----

name: fam
signature: var fam = (cid >= 0 && byCluster[cid]) ? (byCluster[cid].label || n.kind || n.type) : (n.kind || n.type || 'unknown');

name: lkey
signature: function lkey(l) { return l.source + '|' + l.target + '|' + l.type; }

name: a
signature: var a = (2 * Math.PI * k) / Math.max(1, n) - Math.PI / 2;

doc.summary: Exclusive render: exactly one engine owns the pixels.
doc.description: Entering 3D hides every D3 SVG layer; leaving 3D hides the stage and pauses the 3D loop so a hidden WebGL canvas can never stack over 2D or steal pointer events.

name: cross
signature: function cross(o, a, b) { return (a.x - o.x) * (b.y - o.y) - (a.y - o.y) * (b.x - o.x); }

name: mid
signature: var mid = function (a, b) { return { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 }; };

name: rr
signature: function rr(ctx, x, y, w, h, r)

name: glyphPath
signature: function glyphPath(ctx, n, x, y, r)

name: drawGlyph3D
signature: function drawGlyph3D(ctx, n, x, y, r, alpha)

name: drawLabel3D
signature: function drawLabel3D(ctx, n, x, y, r, alpha)

name: segDist
signature: function segDist(x, y, ax, ay, bx, by)

doc.description: Double click, the Enter key or the Expand button pivots through the resolver. Single click never mutates the graph, so inspecting in 3D can no longer repaint a D3 layer on top of the scene.

doc.summary: PNG export composites the WebGL link field with the glyph overlay, so the snapshot matches the screen (native node spheres stay hidden).
Edge inspection in 3D: bridge edges open the cross-reference tooltip, plain edges report their relation.
